{{Top|leg}}
'''Kelek''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kelek commented on the entry for the [[VX3 Scanner]] wide-scan [[Binoculars/Legends|binoculars]], noting that they were an inexpensive alternative to [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
